lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the days when the judges ruled, there was a famine in the land. A man from Bethlehem left his home to live in the country of Moab—his wife and two sons with him.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The man died, and later both sons too. Naomi was left alone with her two daughters-in-law, Orpah and Ruth.

lines.speaker: naomi
lines.text: Go back, each of you, to your mother's home. May the LORD show you kindness, as you have shown kindness to me and to the dead.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Orpah kissed her mother-in-law goodbye. But Ruth clung to her.

lines.speaker: ruth
lines.text: Don't urge me to leave you or to turn back from you. Where you go I will go, and where you stay I will stay. Your people will be my people and your God my God.

choices.label: Pack lightly for the journey
choices.note: Ruth gathers only what she needs for the road ahead.

choices.label: Stay close to Naomi
choices.note: Ruth walks beside her mother-in-law, steadfast in loyalty.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Naomi saw that Ruth was determined to go with her, so she no longer tried to persuade her. Together they set out from Moab toward Bethlehem.
